title: All day awareness

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text: The All Day Awareness technique is a staple of lucid dream practice, in fact, the name is somewhat of a red-herring, as in reality All Day Awareness is simply a modern name for a very ancient psychological and spiritual practice, namely Mindfulness.
